title: Harmonic projections, recurrent extensions and stability of the Liouville property
summary: The Liouville property is a strong form of amenability, but contrary to amenability, it is not well-behaved under extensions. In this paper it is shown that, for every probability measure whose support generates the group as a semigroup, bounded harmonic functions are constant on the cosets of the FC-hypercentre, and more generally of any normal subgroup generated by elements whose centraliser is a recurrent set for the random walk; iterating this construction yields the hyperrecurrent subgroup.
